main_text.p: non abs're hoc loco potissimum recen-seo. Nec enim solùm in urbe semper, nec usquam alibi, sedem tenet, & jus dicit, sed etiam praeter cives opibus & dignitate praecipuos, & in his haud te-merè alios quam confulatu functos, col-legas non admittit: nec ulli praeter sena-tum edendorum collegarum potestatem habent, nec aliunde quam ab eodem se-natu expectare & accipere stipendia an-tiquitus ante dimissam integram libertatem collegae solent. Quo de collegio quamquam multa sparsim hoc libro dicta sint, tamen ut res manifestior fiat, paulo altiùs hic quoque quaedam repetenda. EtDe Ho-vetman-nis differ-tatio. primùm, quae prima collegii hujus, aut Hovetmannorum origo, quod principi-um,dicere non possum. Nec enim id lite-ris proditum usquam, quod sciam.Primos verò in monimentis Reipub. mihi lectos Hovetmannos Kenonianis temporibus, post annum M cccc à natali Domini Ser-vatoris nostri,superiùs ostendi, eosq; tum tributis & tractandae pecuniae per agrum praefuisse memoravi. page.notes: The word "vestigiis" is split as "vesti-" / "gĭs" at the line end; the second part is doubtful (a dot over the i, read here as "giis"). Line 11 "libertatem" is set with a damaged letter; read as "libertatem". The printed "sciam.Primos" lacks a space; left as printed. "M cccc" is kept as printed. The running head printed "Vrbe", which is normalised to "Urbe". The margin note is printed in italic; its hyphens are kept as printed. No catchword or signature appears at the foot.
